description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for Git's upload-pack ref-in-want feature, including setup, configuration, and various tests for repository fetching scenarios.

methods.name: get_actual_refs
methods.description: Parses expected Git references from the output, extracting references between 'wanted-refs' and '0001'.

methods.name: get_actual_commits
methods.description: Unpacks packet lines to fetch commits, verifying pack contents, and sorting commits.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Runs get_actual_refs and get_actual_commits, then compares actual vs expected outputs.

methods.name: write_command
methods.description: Outputs command type and object format if not SHA1.

methods.name: write_fetch_command
methods.description: Outputs a fetch command with want/ref lines and accompanying protocol messages.
